title-group.article-title: Risk of Death Following Application of Paclitaxel‐Coated Balloons and Stents in the Femoropopliteal Artery of the Leg: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials

sec.title: Literature Search
sec.p: The literature search was last updated in August 2018.

sec.title: Included RCTs
sec.p: In all, 28 RCTs with 4663 patients were finally included in the present meta‐analysis (Figure S1).
